title: Pin Release Evidence to the Built Artifact
teaser: A release claim should identify the exact binary that was tested.
full_text: Record artifact hash commit identity and version metadata together then verify later checks reference that immutable tuple.

title: Exercise Cold Start With No Network Route
teaser: Offline support must survive startup before any connection has existed.
full_text: Launch from a cleared process in airplane mode and verify required local tools reach a usable state without network retries blocking UI.

title: Render Mixed Scripts With the Production PDF Font
teaser: A font can pass Latin tests yet fail on symbols used elsewhere in reports.
full_text: Build a report containing contracted Turkish Latin and astrology glyphs then inspect rendered output for missing-character boxes.

title: Reject Restore Before Mutating Data on Version Mismatch
teaser: Compatibility checks belong ahead of database writes.
full_text: Provide a backup with an unsupported schema version and verify restore exits before opening a write transaction.

title: Preserve Birth Location Precision Through Persistence
teaser: Saving and reopening a profile should not silently coarsen calculation inputs.
full_text: Persist a high-precision coordinate fixture reopen it and compare normalized calculation inputs against the original contracted precision.

title: Route Every Upgrade Entry Through One Purchase Surface
teaser: Scattered paywall entry points must not create inconsistent purchase behavior.
full_text: Open upgrade from two unrelated locked features and verify both resolve to the same product and entitlement controller.

title: Disambiguate Places Before Applying Coordinates
teaser: Choosing a city name without region context can select the wrong birthplace.
full_text: Return two same-name locations and verify the user must choose a region-qualified result before coordinates are committed.

title: Normalize Numerology Text Before Character Mapping
teaser: Invisible formatting characters should not become accidental numerology input.
full_text: Compare a clean name with a visually identical string containing zero-width marks and verify normalization follows the documented mapping policy.

title: Represent Missing Solar Events Without Fabrication
teaser: High-latitude days can legitimately lack a sunrise or sunset event.
full_text: Run a polar-day fixture and verify planetary-hour UI exposes an unavailable explanation instead of synthetic event times.

title: Keep Historical Exports Detached From Deleted Profiles
teaser: Deleting live data should not corrupt already-created user artifacts.
full_text: Delete a client after exporting a report and verify the stored report remains readable without recreating the deleted profile.

title: Give Icon-Only Controls Stable Accessible Names
teaser: Assistive labels should survive visual icon replacement.
full_text: Render an icon-only control swap its decorative asset and verify its semantic action name remains unchanged.

title: Recompute Today After a Device Timezone Change
teaser: A cached home screen can cross into the wrong civil day when timezone changes.
full_text: Move the device between zones across a date boundary and verify Today invalidates the prior date snapshot.

title: Round-Trip Multiline Notes Through CSV Safely
teaser: Embedded line breaks must remain data rather than becoming extra records.
full_text: Export a note containing newlines parse the CSV again and verify it returns as one field in one logical row.

title: Lock Aspect Boundary Semantics at the Orb Edge
teaser: Floating-point boundary handling should not differ between calculation and explanation.
full_text: Test values below at and above one orb limit and verify every consuming layer applies the same inclusion rule.

title: Refresh Protected Screens After App Resume
teaser: A purchase state change made while backgrounded must not require an app restart.
full_text: Background the app change entitlement state then resume and verify locked surfaces immediately reevaluate access.

title: Make Report Section Ordering Reproducible
teaser: Identical inputs should not shuffle PDF sections between builds.
full_text: Generate the same report twice and compare parsed heading order as an exact ordered sequence.

title: Test BaZi Day Identity Across a Large UTC Offset
teaser: Local calendar policy can diverge from a naive UTC-date implementation.
full_text: Use a high-offset timezone fixture near midnight and verify day-pillar selection follows the documented civil-time rule.

title: Handle Stale Search Results After Record Deletion
teaser: A cached result should not navigate into a nonexistent object.
full_text: Capture a search result delete its backing record then activate the old result and verify a safe missing-record state is shown.

title: Keep Sensitive Profile Fields Out of Diagnostic Logs
teaser: Operational errors must not expose full personal calculation inputs.
full_text: Trigger a controlled failure and inspect logs for raw names full birth dates and precise coordinates.

title: Include Location in Solar-Event Cache Identity
teaser: Daily astronomy values cannot be reused across unrelated coordinates.
full_text: Calculate the same date for two distant places and verify each receives a separately keyed solar-event cache entry.

title: Keep Navigation Identity Locale-Neutral
teaser: Translated labels should never become route identifiers.
full_text: Invoke the same action in English and Turkish and verify its SCREEN-ID and destination key remain identical.

title: Reject Unsupported Backup Files at Selection Boundary
teaser: A misleading filename should not reach restore parsing as a valid package.
full_text: Choose an unsupported extension and verify the picker handoff fails with an explicit format error before archive inspection.

title: Clear Stale Output When Recalculation Fails
teaser: A previous valid result can be dangerously misleading after a new invalid request.
full_text: Produce one valid calculation then submit invalid input and verify the old result is removed before the error state appears.

title: Stress Core Cards at Maximum Supported Text Scale
teaser: Accessibility sizing should expand layouts without hiding essential controls.
full_text: Render primary cards at the maximum contracted scale and verify text controls and focus bounds remain visible without overlap.

title: Scope Rewarded Access to the Intended Unlock
teaser: One successful reward should not unlock unrelated premium surfaces.
full_text: Complete a rewarded flow for one eligible item and verify other protected features retain their prior entitlement state.

title: Fail Closed When Ephemeris Data Is Unavailable
teaser: Astrology features must not invent a plausible value when their provider fails.
full_text: Force the ephemeris provider to return an error and verify callers receive an explicit unavailable state with no cached guess.

title: Assign a Fresh Identity When Duplicating a Profile
teaser: Copying content must not copy persistence identity.
full_text: Duplicate a saved profile and verify field values can match while primary keys and later edits remain independent.

title: Remove Temporary Share Copies After PDF Delivery
teaser: Transient export files should not accumulate indefinitely in application storage.
full_text: Complete a PDF share flow and verify lifecycle cleanup removes temporary copies while preserving explicitly saved reports.

title: Compare January Shard Keys Against the Calendar
teaser: Matching locale totals can still hide a duplicated date and a missing date.
full_text: Build the expected January 2035 date set and verify both locale shards match it exactly with no duplicate keys.

title: Audit Evidence Ownership Before Advancing RC State
teaser: A green validator should not satisfy requirements outside its semantic scope.
full_text: Compare new evidence owner mappings to the binding requirement text and fail any unrelated RC attachment.

title: Derive the Next Editorial Boundary From Committed Rows
teaser: Progress should follow repository facts rather than a manually entered counter.
full_text: Re-read both January shards verify all 31 dates and derive 2035-02-01 as the next exact editorial start.
